description:
Get ready to test your reflexes and skills in this challenging platformer! Take control of a determined little cat who must overcome obstacles and find the right path to reach its goal.

With simple controls but increasing difficulty, each level demands precision and strategy to move forward. As you progress, new challenges arise, making the journey even more intense. Only the most skilled players will conquer every stage and prove that nothing stands between a cat and its milk!
name: .catMilk 2
intro: The highly successful adventure of the cat who needs to drink milk continues, now the game .catMilk receives its return: .catMilk 2
